summary.text: Stalcup is a Ph.D. physicist, entrepreneur, and self-described former Bernie Sanders supporter running as the Republican nominee. He founded an environmental-monitoring company and campaigns on a "Science Over Politics" platform.

paragraphs.text: Holds a Ph.D. in physics, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.
Founded an environmental-monitoring company whose systems, he says, have been deployed from the Arctic to Antarctica; BallotReady lists him as president of Upward Innovations, Inc. since 2004.
Describes himself as an independent-minded Republican and says he previously supported Bernie Sanders.
Advanced from the September 1, 2026 Republican primary for this seat.

sources.title: Thomas Stalcup, Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses
